reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 14 points better, in a game of about 216 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Bucks.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bucks (revenge, streak).
Bottom line: the Knicks win 79 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 190 and 239 total points.
